title: Simplify first
text: Since $$\ln\left(x^2\right)=2\ln\left(x\right)$$, use the antiderivative of ln(x), which is $$x \ln\left(x\right)-x$$.

title: Evaluate
text: Evaluate $$2\left(x \ln\left(x\right)-x\right)$$ from $$x=1$$ to $$x=e$$. At $$x=e$$ it is $$0$$ and at $$x=1$$ it is $$-2$$, so the answer is $$2$$.
